{'11': '「The most I hear is about how becoming a dad makes you a better person, and I\'m looking forward to it," the "Mad Men" actor said Wednesday during an appearance on the "Today" show.'}

{'11': 'It was reported last month that Hamm and his 38-year-old wife Anna Osceola are expecting their first child together.'}

{'11': 'Smiling, Hamm said, "I\'ve spent my life around kids. I\'ve been a teacher, I have nieces and nephews, and I have a great time with them. Now I\'m really looking forward to starting a family of my own — it\'s both exciting and terrifying."'}

{'11': 'Hamm and Osceola first met during filming of the "Mad Men" finale in 2015, and began dating in 2020.'}

{'11': 'The two got engaged in February 2023 and tied the knot in June of the same year.'}

{'11': 'Prior to marrying Osceola, Hamm was in an 18-year relationship with Jennifer Westfeldt. The two split in September 2015.'}

{'11': 'Hamm previously addressed the possibility of having children late in life during a 2024 interview with The Hollywood Reporter.'}

{'11': 'He said, "I\'m aware that I\'m 53. I\'ll be an old dad, but that\'s just how it is. Maybe it\'s a good thing, we\'ll see."'}

{'11': 'If Hamm needs a fellow over-50 parenting ally, Jamie Foxx recently revealed he, too, will be becoming a father again at 58.'}

{'11': 'During an appearance on "Jimmy Kimmel Live" this week, Foxx punched the air and shouted, "I\'m gonna be a daddy — I can still do it!"'}

{'11': 'He said, "Soon I\'ll be back in the school pickup line. I never hesitated, but you know, at 58, you know what I mean?"'}

{'11': 'Foxx and his 31-year-old girlfriend Alyce Huckstepp are expecting their third child together. He has two other children: 32-year-old Corinne Foxx and 18-year-old Anelise Bishop.'}
